==Description==
'''False-120''' will be one of the many Entities you may encounter within the [[Unnamed Sector]], being the False version of [[A-120]]

==Mechanics==
'''False-120''' will spawn behind the current door waiting a few seconds before rushing back to void wall, after it hits void wall it will return to the current door and slam on it before disappearing.

==Trivia==
False-120 used to be able to snipe, it being an instant kill
